name: Azare
registryBasis: The official Bauchi State government MDA directory links cofo.bauchistate.gov.ng, an anonymous Certificate of Occupancy search service. Its Azare search returned 67 records, establishing a state land-record service with Azare-scoped results; the response was not retained because it exposed unsafe owner/title fields and did not provide parcel geometry.

safeFieldAllowlist: native parcel/record identifier only if independently established
blocker: No safe anonymous parcel geometry or native parcel identity was exposed by the discovered official services. The C of O search is a land-record service, not a qualified geometry adapter.
technicalBlocker: Official C of O search returned records for Azare but only unsafe owner/title-oriented HTML; the advertised BauGIS public viewer exposed no usable parcel API in its current JavaScript/configuration.
uncertainty: The 67-result Azare query demonstrates records matching the search term, not citywide parcel coverage or exact WUP-point coverage.
The Vercel-hosted BauGIS landing page was not independently established as a live government parcel backend.
No parcel sample is retained because no safe native ID plus full polygon was verified.
nextStep: A later attempt may inspect any newly documented official BAGIS map/API endpoint using count-only and ID+geometry-only requests; do not query owner, address, contact, titleholder, tax, or account fields.
identityPolicy: Do not synthesize a parcel identity from search-result row order or internal HTML identifiers.
